organization.name: Alyssa X / Screenity
organization.notes: README identifies solo developer Alyssa X. Exact project start not asserted from relative six-years-ago maker note; corporate sponsors are not equity investors. Funding/ownership beyond individual stewardship unresolved.

pricingTiers.name: Local extension
pricingTiers.notes: No recurring license charge for this core scope; infrastructure and optional services separate.
No explicitly highlighted popular plan verified in the reviewed official offer. No inferred designation.

pricingTiers.name: Pro
pricingTiers.notes: Single paid platform plan shown; no distinct Team/Business tier. $120 billed yearly verified, but not silently substituted for extension code or organizational plan.
Reviewed terms and single-plan page; no separately named enterprise offer found. This is limited to reviewed public plans.

moats.claim: Focused browser capture/annotation workflow differentiates locally, but readily forkable code and limited proprietary ecosystem weaken exclusivity.

productReasons.claim: On-screen drawing, shapes and text explain steps while recording.
Live blur and cursor spotlight guide attention while obscuring sensitive page content.
Trim/crop/audio editing and MP4/GIF/WebM export prepare local clips for reuse.

sponsorship.notes: Recall.ai sponsor banner and HelpKit in-kind help-center hosting identified in README; no inference from ordinary integrations.

requirements.notes: Load released Build.zip as unpacked extension; local-only runtime, not a server.

requirements.condition: Source development/build only; released extension needs no Node server
Optional Google Drive upload integration; local recording does not require it

resources.notes: No universal hardware minimum established; workload determines capacity.

selfHosting.notes: Browser extension/local desktop workflow, not server hosting. Self-hosted extension is local-only; API, sign-in and Pro platform features disabled.

options.name: Official Chrome Web Store extension
options.notes: Installs official distributed extension; separate manual unpacked self-host build stays local-only and excludes Pro platform.

oneClickInstall.notes: Official README Get it now link verified to Chrome Web Store. Marketplace installs browser extension, not web sharing server.
